_doc: SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 answers for the Replication Ledger tenant. Safeguards map to instances/replication-ledger/runway.json; read by foundation/seedlife.py. deploy.worker stays empty until the topology entry lands with its own repository (TENANT-REPO-1).

budget.how: runway.json ai-cost: the ledger needs no model; standings are computed by standing.js

models.how: runway.json model-retired: standings need no model; candidate labelling waits when no model answers

health.how: the watchdog fetches the verify URL every pass once it is set

improvement.how: the weekly discovery beat is the next slice; until it lands new replications are filed with cli.mjs add

privacy.how: no accounts or cookies; the first slice serves read-only JSON and records nothing about readers
